tonal.role: reproducible composition, distribution, integration and release layer

project.name: Tonal
project.architecture: three independently versioned repositories composed by exact immutable commits

tlaloc.authority: behavior compilation, swarm orchestration, training, verification and Tlaloque execution

origami.authority: representation, visual/computational language, state machines and deterministic experimental evidence

ownership.component_semantics: owned only by each component repository

notes: Tlaloc and Origami remain independently versioned and authoritative for their own semantics.
Tonal is the single authority for project-agnostic repo-flow distribution and stack composition.
Origami reference experiments are evidence-driven and their CI gate must remain green before Tonal promotes a new Origami commit.
A Tonal composition promotes exact commits, never floating branches.
